definitions.explanation: A general term for cereal grains including wheat, barley, oats, and rye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{麦茶|むぎちゃ}→麦茶：16494_mugicha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。

examples.english: This wheat is planted in autumn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧、{麦|むぎ}⟦わら→わら：27567_wara⟧⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶって→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧{麦|むぎ}⟦{畑|ばたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: When summer came, I would put on a straw hat and walk through the wheat fields.

notes:
{麦|むぎ} is a general term covering several cereal grains. Unlike English, which distinguishes wheat, barley, oats, and rye with separate words, Japanese uses {麦|むぎ} as the umbrella term.

TYPES:
- ⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧: wheat (most common in bread, noodles)
- ⟦{大麦|おおむぎ}→大麦：12215_oomugi⟧: barley (used for tea, beer)
- ⟦{燕麦|えんばく}→燕麦：noentry⟧: oats
- ⟦ライ{麦|むぎ}→ライ麦：23185_raimugi⟧: rye

COMMON PRODUCTS:
- ⟦{麦茶|むぎちゃ}→麦茶：16494_mugicha⟧: barley tea (a staple cold drink in summer)
- {麦|むぎ}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: rice cooked with barley
- {麦|むぎ}⟦わら→わら：27567_wara⟧⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧: straw hat
- {麦|むぎ}⟦{畑|ばたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧: wheat/barley field

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{麦茶|むぎちゃ}→麦茶：16494_mugicha⟧ is one of the most common beverages in Japanese households, especially during summer.
